audit.why: 54.07% WR over 3967 games — Syndra-favoured lane; Galio's threat is taunt all-ins and global R roams, not lane pressure. TRICKY 7/10 is defensible given his MR profile and engage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[] read 'Syndra' on all seven — the layers disagreed everywhere. Content whys, the packet levelChart (Syndra 7/7) and the 54.07% WR all back Syndra.
audit.why: regression-check fails disagreeing layers; the content layer is the grounded one here (out-range vs a W-sustain tank with one dash).
audit.corrected: All seven full sides moved Skill -> Syndra with whys rewritten to be Galio-specific in the same group; win[] untouched (already correct, so side edits alone per the chart rule).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; two copy-paste-bleed bullets; missing verified interactions: Colossal Smash (P) is an auto-reset burst tell, and Justice Punch (E) can cut Syndra's dashless retreat — Flash is the answer to the wall, not the damage.
audit.why: Kit: Galio E 11/10/9/8/7s (his only engage), W 18-14s taunt/shield, R 180s global. Both missingInteractions verified against Riot's text.
audit.corrected: Numbers added; bleed bullets replaced with the E flight-path cue and the hold-Flash-for-the-cutoff rule; auto-reset tell folded into enemyWin.

edits.before: Q on every last-hit he takes — your level 1 poke is the best in the mage pool. Leave spheres on the ground; they're ammo.
edits.after: Q on every last-hit he takes — Galio's W damage-cut helps him, but at level 1 he has no answer to 800-range poke.

edits.before: Q-E already threatens the stun — most mids don't respect it at 2 and pay a Flash for the lesson.
edits.after: Q-E already threatens the stun — Galio's only step-up is E, and QE punishes the wind-up every time.

edits.before: Full kit: W-slow into QE stun into Q again is a half-bar rotation. The lane is yours to bully from here.
edits.after: Full kit: W-slow into QE stun into Q again is a half-bar rotation his W damage-cut only blunts, never stops.

edits.before: Splinter stacks build toward empowered Q — keep poking; every sphere thrown is scaling AND pressure at once.
edits.after: Splinter stacks build toward empowered Q — keep poking; his 18s W cannot soak every sphere you throw.

edits.before: Unleashed Power online — count spheres before every trade: three-plus on the field means most mids die to R alone.
edits.after: Unleashed Power online — and his R is a roam tool, not a duel button: shove first and follow or punish the global.

edits.before: Luden's spike: QE-stun into full rotation deletes squishies. Force the wave contact trades he cannot refuse.
edits.after: Luden's spike: your burst out-paces his W sustain while it is down — force trades on the 18-second window.

edits.before: Late Syndra is a one-button court-martial: flank, QE the carry, R the verdict. Spheres on the ground are sentences waiting.
edits.after: Late, respect the flank taunt but out-range it: QE the carry, R the verdict, and never fight inside his five-man W.

edits.before: Galio wins by landing Justice Punch, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Galio wins by landing Justice Punch into taunt — his Colossal Smash auto reset opens the burst, so the wind-up is your step-back cue.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Scatter the Weak like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch (E): 11s at rank 1 — his only engage; down, he has none. - W taunt 18s: both down he cannot fight. - Guard your E Scatter the Weak like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: His E charges in a straight line after a step back — the step-back is your cue: sphere between you and QE the approach lane.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: He can cut your retreat with Justice Punch and you have no dash — hold Flash for the wall he makes of himself, not for damage.

notes: Full layer carried a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows against a fully-Syndra content layer — the previously-stalling case; per the settled chart rule the sides move alone (win[] already correct) with every why rewritten Galio-specific in the same atomic group. Ratings left as-is. Both missingInteractions folded in (P auto-reset into enemyWin, E retreat-cut into dontsFull[2].d). Content layer is accurate and name-correct — untouched.
